main.hero_title: Decision Support System for evaluating investment alternatives
main.hero_desc: The system provides automation for multi-criteria evaluation of investment projects, formalization of analysis methodologies, and centralized storage of calculation results.
main.hero_step1: Investor creates an evaluation scenario and a list of alternatives
main.hero_step2: admin-analyst defines factors, weights, and runs calculations
main.hero_step3: System generates a ranked list and an analytical conclusion
main.ctx_sub: Prior to the implementation of the system, the evaluation of investment alternatives was carried out mainly manually using office tools. This approach was characterized by a number of systemic drawbacks.
main.ctx_c1_d: Manual processing of a large number of alternatives in spreadsheets required substantial time resources from the admin-analyst.
main.ctx_c2_d: The absence of a unified methodology led to different results when evaluating identical alternatives by different admin-analysts.
main.ctx_c3_d: Data was stored in fragmented files without a centralized repository, which complicated auditing and reuse of results.
main.proc_s1_d: Investor defines the list of investment alternatives, risk coefficients, and describes the requirements for evaluation criteria.
main.proc_s2_d: The admin-analyst forms the matrix of evaluation factors, determines their types and weights, enters values, and triggers the automatic calculation.
main.proc_s3_d: The system generates a ranked list of alternatives adjusted for risk, creates a textual conclusion, and generates a graphical visualization of the results.
main.out_sub: Based on the calculation results, the system generates the following output materials to support decision-making.
main.out_c1_d: Alternatives are ordered by an integral efficiency metric, taking into account the individual risk coefficient of each project.
main.out_c2_d: An automatically generated textual conclusion for each alternative: recommended, requires consideration, or not recommended.
main.out_c3_d: Comparative charts across evaluation factors for a clear analysis of the strengths and weaknesses of each alternative.
main.roles_pm_d: Creates evaluation scenarios for investment alternatives, defines analysis requirements, and receives the system's analytical conclusions.
main.roles_an_d: Processes evaluation scenarios, forms the criteria matrix, enters metric values, and runs the calculation procedure.
